card_says: Consortium that built and runs the dam
source_says: Santo Antonio Energia is a company, not a consortium. Furnas, an Eletrobras subsidiary and a shareholder, calls it a specific-purpose company and gives the plant a minimum installed capacity of 3,568.8 MW, online since March 2012, with headquarters at Porto Velho. On the ownership, two credible sources differ: a 27 May 2022 report gives Madeira Energia S.A. (MESA) shareholders as Furnas 43.06%, Caixa FIP Amazonia Energia 19.63%, Novonor (formerly Odebrecht) 18.25%, SAAG (Andrade Gutierrez) 10.53% and Cemig 8.53%, while the undated Furnas page lists Furnas 39%, Caixa FIP Amazonia Energia 20%, Odebrecht Energia do Brasil 18.6%, SAAG Investimentos 12.4% and Cemig 10%, and describes the holdings as those of the parent company without stating whether they are in Santo Antonio Energia, MESA or both. The Furnas page also calls Santo Antonio Energia the parent of MESA, the reverse of the 2022 report.
